Neema Olomi daga Tanzania ta zama mai nasara na 2026 Nigeria Ladies Open bayan gama wasa na zagaye uku a IBB International Golf and Country Club, Abuja, yayin da golfers na Nigeria suka kasa samun wurin jiya a top 10. articles.title: Sex Outside Marriage: Saudi Arabia Sentences Kenyan Mother To 100 Lashes, Spares Child’s Father

The father, identified only as Mohamud, an Egyptian resident, reportedly left Saudi Arabia after […]
articles.hausa_translation: Jaridar Saudi Arabia ta yanke hukunci kan wata macewar kasuwa daga Kenya, Esther Wanja Muthoni, mai shekaru 40, zuwa bugi 100 saboda yin jima'i a wajen ba aure ba bayan ta haifi jari a gida. Mahaifin jarin, wanda ake kira Mohamud, dan Egypt, bai karɓi wani hukunci ba kuma ya tafi daga Saudi Arabia.
critical_questions: Why was the father, an Egyptian resident, able to leave the country without facing prosecution for the same offense, and what does this reveal about enforcement disparities based on nationality and gender?
What was Esther's testimony regarding consent and circumstances, and how were those details weighed against the legal judgment?

articles.title: Nearly 64,000 Nigerians flee to Niger over insecurity – UNHCR

critical_questions: Why does UNHCR specifically highlight Niger as the destination - are these refugees receiving adequate support there, or is this a displacement crisis compounding regional instability?
